# vktMeshShaderPropertyTestsEXT

## Overview

EXT property tests cover limits and shader-backed uses of payload, shared-memory, output-count, view, layer, and output-size properties.

## File Role

This is a registered mesh-shader test source file. Its registered group names and direct children are documented from the inspected registration code in [vktMeshShaderPropertyTestsEXT.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/mesh_shader/vktMeshShaderPropertyTestsEXT.cpp#L2429).

## Parameter Dimensions

Dimensions include payload/shared-memory mode, primitive/vertex output counts, payload on/off, per-primitive/per-vertex location, and view-index mode.

## Support and Feature Requirements

Mesh shader tests require the corresponding extension and requested task/mesh feature bits through the shared helpers in [vktMeshShaderUtil.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/mesh_shader/vktMeshShaderUtil.cpp#L111) and [vktMeshShaderUtil.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/mesh_shader/vktMeshShaderUtil.cpp#L126). Additional per-file gates are described where observed in the implementation.
